articles.author: GENERATION INCOME PROPERTIES, INC.
articles.headline: Generation Income Properties reports Nasdaq bid-price compliance deadline extension
articles.summary: GIPR reports a Nasdaq Hearings Panel exception extending its deadline to regain minimum-bid compliance until November 18. The extension continues the opportunity to cure the deficiency; it is not restored compliance or a guarantee against future delisting.
